commit: claude/apps-runner-tracking on 50daaac (PR 8 branch, built from the working tree before commit)
session: Dev session against the local memory API (port 3001) behind a switchable proxy on 3000 that drops every connection to simulate a dead zone. Race seeded with the 50K fixture course started 2 h earlier and a 2 h backlog of 40 samples uploaded in one batch; a second race with no pings for the empty states.
action: Athlete opened crewcue://dev/location-heartbeat with fine and background location granted and tapped Start tracking (RaceTrackingService started in the foreground). Relaunched inside the dead zone (service resumed from the saved session), then ended the dead zone. Location revoked and 'Don't allow' tapped for Error.

checked.Success: 'Tracking. Your crew sees your position.'; the service's sample reached the server (batch accepted 1).
checked.Empty: 'No location sample yet.' before Start tracking.
checked.Error: 'Don't allow' on the location prompt: 'Location permission was denied.' (copy aligned with iOS in this PR)
checked.Offline: Dead zone: 'Offline. Sample queued in the outbox.'; after it ended the next refresh sent both queued samples in one batch (accepted 2) and showed 'Location sample sent.'
